## Behavior

Describe the reusable backup, verification, signing, or restore behavior changed.

## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] Public API compatibility is preserved or versioned.
- [ ] Archive-format compatibility is preserved or versioned.
- [ ] Trust, extraction limits, paths, and failure recovery were considered.
- [ ] Human-facing behavior and format documentation are current.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] Normal round-trip coverage
- [ ] Adversarial coverage where archive or filesystem handling changed
